About

I care about the moment an idea becomes understandable.

AH Writer & Researcher

I am a Malaysia-based student writer interested in research, persuasion and the craft of making difficult ideas easy to understand.

Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia Available for selected freelance projects

I write for readers who are busy, curious and unwilling to fight their way through vague language. My work begins with understanding the idea properly, then shaping it into something clear, useful and memorable.

I am especially drawn to science, education, technology and thoughtful personal writing. I can also adapt tone for websites, founder posts, articles and editorial projects.

I am early in my professional journey, so I compete on preparation, responsiveness and care. I do not pretend to know what I do not know; I research it, ask better questions and revise until the writing earns its place.

Principles

The standards I want the work to meet.

Clarity before cleverness

The reader should understand the point before admiring the sentence.

Research with restraint

Evidence should strengthen the argument, not bury it under unnecessary detail.

Voice, not imitation

Ghostwriting should sound like the client on their clearest and most thoughtful day.

Revision is the work

The first draft discovers the idea. The later drafts make it worth reading.

Next step

The portfolio is the best introduction.

Read a few pieces, notice the range, then get in touch with the kind of work you need.
